subject.title: feat(agents): inject Recently Completed Subagents into parent prompt

question: Should OpenClaw inject recently completed child-run anchors into eligible parent-agent prompts by default for 30 minutes?
rationale: This PR intentionally changes core orchestration context rather than repairing a documented broken API contract, and independent source review was unavailable in this environment.

options.title: Accept bounded completion anchors
options.body: Approve the default 30-minute, newest-eight completion summary if the owner confirms it is the intended orchestration policy.

options.title: Keep completion state out of default prompts
options.body: Retain completion details in existing handoff and inspection paths instead of adding them to later parent-agent system prompts.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded completion anchors
recommendation.body: Approve the default 30-minute, newest-eight completion summary if the owner confirms it is the intended orchestration policy.
